# mimecast_address_alteration_definitions (Data Source)

Read all Address Alteration definitions through the legacy filtered read contract with deterministic ordering.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_address_alteration_definitions" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable Address Alteration definition inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `address_type` (String) Address component altered by the definition.
- `folder_id` (String) Containing Address Alteration Set ID.
- `id` (String) Address Alteration definition ID.
- `new_address` (String, Sensitive) Replacement address pattern.
- `original_address` (String, Sensitive) Original address pattern.
- `routing` (String) Mail route to which the definition applies.
